recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓左側為混雜紅血球、大型未成熟細胞與深染小核紅血球前驅細胞的浸潤，右側則是一片較密集、核卵圓或有凹痕的中型細胞；整體為骨髓單核系細胞大量充塞紅髓，符合 JMML 侵犯脾臟。
features: Red pulp expanded by a dense hematopoietic infiltrate with loss of normal cord/sinus contrast
Left half: large immature cells with vesicular, oval to folded nuclei and nucleoli admixed with abundant red cells
Erythroid precursors with small dense round nuclei and scattered maturing granulocytes
Right half: densely packed medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm (monocytoid infiltrate versus residual white pulp)
No necrosis or discrete tumor nodule
describe_en: H&E section of spleen shows marked expansion of the red pulp by a dense hematopoietic infiltrate. On the left, large immature cells with vesicular oval to folded nuclei and nucleoli are admixed with erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and abundant red cells; on the right, the infiltrate is more densely packed and composed of medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Whether the denser area represents a monocytic infiltrate or residual white pulp cannot be determined on H&E alone and requires immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Trilineage red pulp hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and without a dense monocytic component.
Shows sheets of blasts with CD34/CD117 positivity and little maturation.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by B-lymphoblastic or other lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells would be CD19/PAX5 or CD3 positive and MPO/CD14-negative, forming white pulp–based or diffuse monotonous sheets.
